'''2007 Dantooine Regionals Bob Hiltz DS Coruscant: Imperial City''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bob Hiltz]] at [[2007 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Imperial City|SE-D-coruscantimperialcity.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
